towns.name: Eastwatch
towns.summary: Eastwatch (90.3N 43.1W) is the garrison outpost of Viamontian knights on the eastern shore of the Isle of Ruin, the most dangerous of the Halaetan Isles (the frozen Shattered Out-Lands lie at its northern head): an outpost of Sanamar full of kill-task givers, beer-brewing ingredients and four Grand Master scriveners. It stands on an ice-and-clay plateau at z 170 whose eastern face is a near-vertical 170 m sea cliff dropping to an ice shelf and the sea, with 25-34 m ice spires on the shore, the Coral Caves entrance offshore and the Undead Temple at the northern cliff foot. Two four-storey stone lighthouse towers with golden tapered roofs (26 m) flank a stone keep-tower with a golden roof (25 m) and a stone house with a smoking chimney; five golden lamps burn with blue flames around a wooden mirror shrine, the Life Stone, the Town Network portal and the destroyed portal to Sanamar.
